test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence which has no spelling error.

options.text: There are more than 3500 types of moskuitoes in the world.
The common reaction to mosquiteo’s biting is itching.
Female mosqueteos have a longer life than their male mates.
Like all flies, mosquitoes also have four stages in their life.

solution:
The correct answer is, '**Like all flies, mosquitoes also have four stages in their life**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This sentence has no spelling errors - **Like all flies mosquitoes also have four stages in their life**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **There are more than 3500 types of moskuitoes in the world**. 

 
 
• Incorrect - Moskuitoes. Correct - Mosquitoes.
 
 
 
• **The common reaction to mosquiteo's biting is itching**.
 
 
• Incorrect - Mosquiteo's. Correct - Mosquito's biting 
 
 
 
• **Female mosqueteos have a longer life than their male mates.**
 
 
• Incorrect - Mosqueteos. Correct - Mosquitoes.
